risk_summary: The excerpt is dominated by standard forward-looking-risk disclaimers and broad, difficult-to-quantify uncertainties involving regulation, reserves, competition, investments, catastrophe exposure, and economic conditions. Although it provides meaningful operating and reserve-related figures, repeated caveats and extensive boilerplate limit clarity regarding the magnitude and likelihood of key risks. Reported profitability and cash generation are positive, but earnings declined materially year over year and results remain sensitive to claims development and investment performance.
